Save a figure at journal size

Source: R/plots.R
op_save.Rd

Wrapper around ggplot2::ggsave() with standard journal widths, 300 dpi, and sensible devices: ragg for PNG/TIFF when installed, Cairo for PDF, and vector SVG/PDF/EPS.

Usage

op_save(
  plot,
  filename,
  width = "single",
  height = NULL,
  aspect = 0.62,
  dpi = 300
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object.

filename

Output file; the extension picks the format (png, pdf, svg, tiff, eps).

width

"single" (85 mm), "onehalf" (120 mm), "double" (178 mm), or a number in millimetres.

height

Height in mm; default width * aspect.

aspect

Height / width when height is NULL (default 0.62).

dpi

Resolution for raster formats (default 300).

Value

The file path, invisibly.

Examples

p <- op_plot_trend(op_example[op_example$ab_name %in% c("Amoxicillin", "Doxycycline"), ], y = "items")
f <- op_save(p, tempfile(fileext = ".png"), width = "single")
file.exists(f)
#> [1] TRUE
